_comment: Performance refactor of UnitManeuver.gd: is_sidestep, is_rear_move, etc.
caption: Non-visual refactor: replaces `distance_to` (`length()`) calls with `distance_squared_to` (`length_squared()`) inside `scripts/UnitManeuver.gd`. Evaluates maneuver check logic like `is_sidestep` and `is_rear_move` using squared thresholds instead of expensive sqrts. A recorded clip remains byte-for-byte identical.
